applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Physical World Card does not support ATM cash withdrawal under this service schedule.

Whether a point-of-sale transaction requests a PIN depends on the acquiring side and the applicable local arrangement. There is no separate World Card “small amount without PIN” toggle.

The physical-card issuance fee can be paid from the e-commerce balance or the eligible same-name balance. E-commerce is the default selection; where the Portal offers a choice, select the intended funding account before issuance.

For a failed physical-card transaction, retain its actual error and the merchant context for investigation. A physical card's possession does not change the balance, limit or verification requirements of the account funding it.
